text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though defeated, Tamamo Cross looked back 
at the Kyoto track with a surprisingly 
content expression.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This experience also served as preparation 
for running the Tenno Sho (Spring), a 
Senior-tier GⅠ and another Kyoto 
long-distance race that held special 
sentimental value for her father.
